bundle.shortDescription: Fast, local-first Windows search and command palette
bundle.longDescription: ProtonSearch finds files, folders, documents, apps, clipboard items, browser history, Git activity and actions from one keyboard shortcut. Everything is indexed and searched locally on your PC.
